title: [DEBUG] Retrieval stage failure: Cases 7,12,15,16 return zero candidates
description:
P0 diagnostic issue: improved evidence_selector did not help Cases 7,12,15,16 because 
the ROOT PROBLEM is at RETRIEVAL STAGE, not selection stage.

Evidence:
- Candidate Recall@300 = 0.0 for Cases 7,12,15,16
- This means NO papers were retrieved, so selection stage never runs
- Contrast with 1st eval (cc81b61): Case 12 had Candidate Recall=1.0 but F1=0 
  (meaning papers WERE retrieved but selection failed)

Now both components fail:
1. Retrieval returns 0 papers (NEW problem)
2. Selection still can't filter correctly (original problem)

Hypothesis: Changes to query routing/sanitization in commit cc81b61 
may have broken retrieval for non-Case-1 queries.

Blocked on:
- Investigating why query_generation or multi_route causes 0 candidate retrieval
- Comparing retrieval behavior between baseline and current version
notes: This explains why evidence_selector improvements had no effect on final F1.

title: Debug zero-recall on Cases 7, 12, 15, 16 - investigate LLM response failures
description:
After stabilization refactor, evaluation shows F1=0 on 4 non-Case-1 queries due to LLM failures:
- Case 7: empty llm response in batch evidence selection
- Case 12: JSON parse error (Expecting ',' delimiter)
- Case 15: no candidate papers in evaluation
- Case 16: empty llm response + JSON parse error

Candidate Recall@300 shows papers ARE being retrieved (Case 12 has 1.0), so issue is in evidence_selector filtering step, not in retrieval stage.

Need to investigate:
1. Why evidence_selector returns empty payloads for these cases
2. If fallback_selection is working correctly
3. Whether batch processing or LLM response parsing is the root cause
notes: Evaluation baseline: Case 1 F1=0.5, Cases 7,12,15,16 F1=0. Wall time avg 84s (approaching budget).
